diagnostic_checks: validation error is separated from calibration error
interpretability and decision relevance are included
alternative models are preserved rather than erased
ranking_method: Validation error plus complexity penalty minus interpretability, robustness, and decision-relevance credits.

selection_register.review_question: Is added complexity justified by evidence?

selection_register.review_question: Can users understand why this model was selected?

selection_register.modeling_role: Reviews stability under assumptions and stress
selection_register.review_question: Does the preferred model remain credible under uncertainty?

selection_register.modeling_role: Links model selection to the intended use
